description: This PHP class `EmploymentContractModel` is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the PIM API module. It models an employment contract by serializing an `EmpContract` entity with properties such as start date, end date, and contract attachment details, and provides metadata for API documentation.

classes.name: EmploymentContractModel
classes.description: A model class used to serialize employment contract data for API responses, mapping properties from the `EmpContract` entity with defined filters and attribute names.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an `EmpContract` entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
